refresh_token.description: Your Wolt consumer refresh token. In a logged-in Wolt browser tab, open DevTools > Application > Cookies and copy the value of the __wrtoken cookie, without the surrounding quotes. This is not the Bearer token from an Authorization header. Treat it like a password.
